facts.text: The image is a multi-panel creature reference sheet showing one dark dragon design, with a large hero view at the top and seven smaller labeled panels below.
The top hero view shows a large black dragon standing low on rocky, wet ground with its wings partly spread and its head lowered; faint orange embers or reflections appear in the dark background.
The dragon has dark charcoal-to-black scales with subtle blue-green highlights, long ivory or bone-colored horns swept back from the head, and a spiky ridge along the neck and back.
Its wings are large and bat-like, with dark leathery membranes stretched over visible finger-like supports.
A long tapering tail extends behind the body, and the feet have prominent curved claws.
The middle row contains full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR against a plain dark gray background.
The bottom row contains close-up panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the head in profile with a pale amber eye, overlapping facial scales, and several long horns.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with subtle blue-green highlights.
The lighting is low-key and moody: cool gray-blue ambient light overall, with warm orange glow or reflected embers in the hero landscape and softer studio-style light in the reference panels.
The visible labels are set in white sans-serif capital letters beneath or within their panels.

limitations: The composite reference sheet does not establish the dragon's real-world scale, behavior, or details outside the depicted panels.
Some fine surface detail in the dark areas is visually obscured by the low-key lighting.
